# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from `crates/koru-keys/src/registry.rs`. Do not edit by hand:
`cargo test -p koru-keys` fails when this file and the table disagree,
and `KORU_UPDATE_SHORTCUTS=1 cargo test -p koru-keys` rewrites it. -->

Chords are shown as this platform writes them.

## Window

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+N` | New window |
| `Ctrl+Shift+T` | Keep window on top |
| `Ctrl+=` | Zoom in |
| `Ctrl+-` | Zoom out |
| `Ctrl+0` | Actual size |
| `Ctrl+Tab` | Next tab |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | Previous tab |
| `Alt+←` | Back |
| `Alt+→` | Forward |
| `Ctrl+Shift+D` | Dictate |

## Terminal

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+C` | Copy or interrupt |
| `Ctrl+Shift+C` | Copy selection |
| `Ctrl+V` | Paste |
| `Ctrl+Shift+V` | Paste |
| `Ctrl+,` | Settings |
| `Ctrl+Shift+E` | Explore |
